question_text: In an experiment to determine the specific latent heat of fusion ($L$) of ice using method of mixtures, a student obtained a value of L which is lower than the standard value. Reasons for the lower value for L have been explained by the student with the following statements:

options.option_text: It may have been due to ice may have not been properly wiped out before adding to the calorimeter.
Water on the pieces of ice dew being formed on the outer surface of the calorimeter while doing the experiment.
Temperature of the ice used may have been lower than 0$^\circ C$.
only A and B can be accepted
only B and C can be accepted
